hr-h1.title: Paint that makes it look brand new.

hr-ld.paragraph: Interior and exterior painting for homes and commercial buildings across the Clearwater area: careful prep, clean lines and a finish that holds up to Florida sun.

sv-hd-ld.paragraph: One crew from the first walkthrough to the final touch-up, so the color you picked is the color you get.

sv0-p.paragraph: Full house repaints with pressure-clean, scrape, caulk and prime, then a coating built for coastal weather.

sv1-p.paragraph: Walls, ceilings, trim and accent walls, with floors and furniture protected and clean, crisp edges.

sv2-p.paragraph: Offices, warehouses and storefronts, scheduled around your business hours.

sv3-p.paragraph: Salt, sun and humidity are hard on paint. We prep stucco and wood so the new coat lasts.

sv4-p.paragraph: Deck staining, railings, pavilions and pergolas, finished to stand up to rain and UV.

sv5-p.paragraph: Front doors, shutters, railings and trim, the small details that make a house pop.

sv-also.paragraph: Also ask about: cabinet painting · pressure washing · drywall & popcorn-ceiling repair · floor coatings.

ba-hd-ld.paragraph: Real jobs from our Google listing. Tired, faded exteriors turned fresh and clean.

ba1-h.title: Gray stucco ranch · to crisp white

ba2-h.title: Coastal stilt home · from faded pink to white & seafoam

ba3-h.title: Historic two-story · from worn to fresh

pr0-d.paragraph: We look at the job, talk colors and scope, and give you a clear written price.

pr1-d.paragraph: Washing, scraping, patching and priming. This is what keeps paint from peeling.

pr2-d.paragraph: Sharp lines, tidy work and everything protected, inside and out.

pr3-d.paragraph: We check every detail with you and touch up before we call it done.

ab-h.title: Locally owned, and we treat your home like our own

ab-p.paragraph: Miracle Painting LLC is a Clearwater painting company serving homeowners, landlords and local businesses. We keep the process simple: show up on time, prep right, paint clean and stand behind the finish.

ab-area.paragraph: Service area: Clearwater · Largo · Dunedin · Safety Harbor · Oldsmar · Belleair · St. Petersburg · all of Pinellas County

es-p.paragraph: Send a few details and we’ll reach out to set up a time to look at it. Prefer to talk? Give us a call.

es-fb.paragraph: The estimate form is loading. You can also call (727) 555-0100.

fo-fine.paragraph: Demo notice. This page is a website concept prepared by Axiom Systems for Miracle Painting LLC and is not their official site. The phone number is a placeholder, services and descriptions are illustrative, and the photographs are from their Google Business listing. The estimate form is a demonstration and sends nothing.
